title: Independent reading: Romans 8:18–30
subtitle: Read groaning, hope, and purpose across connected paragraphs.
overview: Romans 8:18–30 uses repeated creation, groaning, hope, Spirit, and purpose vocabulary to bind several units. Build a repetition map alongside the clause map.
The passage has long sentences and theological vocabulary; identify grammar and paragraph movement before making systematic conclusions.

items.en: For in hope we were saved.

items.grc: οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν.
items.en: And we know that for those who love God all things work together for good.
